section: ICT in Andhra Pradesh - e-Pragati, RTGS, Mee Seva and state digital initiatives
subsections: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: The Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) of Andhra Pradesh is best described as:
o: A flagship digital-governance platform using real-time data and technology-based monitoring
A rural broadband network based exclusively on satellite communication
A registration platform operated by private document writers
A citizen-service centre network restricted to municipal corporations
accepted.x: RTGS is Andhra Pradesh’s flagship digital-governance platform, using technology-based monitoring and real-time dashboards for governance.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional description rather than a related digital initiative.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: Which of the following technologies is NOT specifically identified as being used by the Real Time Governance Society?
accepted.x: RTGS uses Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, GIS, IoT and real-time dashboards. Blockchain is not identified among these technologies.
accepted.tq: Find the one technology outside the stated set.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: The technological architecture of RTGS includes which of the following components?
o: Data Bank, Data Grid and State Cyber Tribunal
Data Lake, Data Lens and Command & Control Centre
Cloud Vault, Data Lens and District Courts
Data Lake, Satellite Grid and Revenue Command Centre
accepted.x: RTGS operates through its Data Lake, Data Lens and Command & Control Centre, supported by real-time dashboards.
accepted.tq: Use the exact institutional terminology and reject look-alike names.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s:
With reference to RTGS, consider the following statements:
1. A Singapore delegation studied the platform in July 2026.
2. The study related to Andhra Pradesh’s digital-governance model.
3. The platform was studied only for its village road-construction technology.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: A Singapore delegation studied RTGS in July 2026 as a digital-governance platform. The study was not restricted to village road-construction technology.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme narrowing word ‘only’ while retaining the two related statements.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: The AI City Flood Alert platform associated with RTGS is linked with which organisation?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education
Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority
accepted.x: The AI City Flood Alert platform was developed in association with the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA).
accepted.tq: Match the digital tool with the correct state institution.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: In July 2026, the Chief Minister at RTGS headquarters ordered a redraft of the Business Rules and directed attention to:
o: Replacement of GIS with paper maps
accepted.x: The July 2026 directions included redrafting the Business Rules and strengthening crowd-sourced grievance tracking.
accepted.tq: Link the reported administrative order with its specific governance objective.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: Village and Ward Secretariats in Andhra Pradesh were introduced in 2019. Which combination correctly represents their scale as stated?
o: More than 10,000 secretariats and exactly 50 services
More than 500 secretariats and more than 10,000 services
More than 10,000 secretariats and more than 500 services
More than 5,000 secretariats and more than 100 services
accepted.x: The Village and Ward Secretariat system, introduced in 2019, comprises more than 10,000 secretariats delivering more than 500 services.
accepted.tq: Pair the year with both quantitative indicators instead of swapping the figures.
accepted.sec: RTGS - command centre, dashboards, Village and Ward Secretariat delivery

accepted.s: The network topology selected for the APSFL network is:
accepted.x: The APSFL network uses an IP-MPLS ring topology, which was selected over GPON.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the selected topology and the specifically rejected alternative.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes ‘triple play’ under AP FiberNet?
accepted.x: Triple play under AP FiberNet consists of internet, IPTV and voice services.
accepted.tq: Decode the service bundle by identifying all three components.

accepted.s: The last-mile connectivity of the APSFL network runs through approximately:
accepted.x: The APSFL last mile runs through more than 6,300 local cable operators. The other figures refer to different digital-infrastructure counts.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely placed quantitative figures by their units and scale.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding institutional links under AP FiberNet:
1. It links 5,000 RSK centres.
2. It links 1,300 Primary Health Centres.
3. It links 6,500 schools.
4. The total number of government connections is more than 22,000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: the network links 5,000 RSK centres, 1,300 PHCs, 6,500 schools and more than 22,000 government connections in all.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement separately before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has ranked Andhra Pradesh among the highest states in respect of:
accepted.x: TRAI ranks Andhra Pradesh among the highest states in rural broadband.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact performance indicator rather than a neighbouring infrastructure sector.

accepted.s: AP FiberNet has reached more than 4,000 remote tribal hamlets located in the:
accepted.x: The network has reached more than 4,000 remote tribal hamlets in the Eastern Ghats.
accepted.tq: Use the location clue to distinguish the correct geographical region.

accepted.s: The significance of Andhra Pradesh’s e-governance legacy is associated with which combination?
o: The Singapore delegation and the introduction of GPON topology
The APSFL network and the construction of the Eastern Ghats
N. Chandrababu Naidu’s SMART governance model and the HITEC City IT push of 1995–2004
The e-Cabinet initiative of Himachal Pradesh and the IT push of 2019
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh’s e-governance legacy is linked with N. Chandrababu Naidu’s SMART governance model and the HITEC City IT push during 1995–2004.
accepted.tq: Combine the associated person, governance model and time period precisely.

accepted.s:
Consider the following developments and their reported time references:
1. Review of RTGS by a Singapore delegation — July 2026
2. Registration Service Kendras — July 2026
3. Mana Mitra temple revenue — June 2026
4. Amended BharatNet Memorandum of Cooperation for 13,426 panchayats — February 2026
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four developments and their stated time references are correctly matched: RTGS and Registration Service Kendras in July 2026, Mana Mitra temple revenue in June 2026, and the amended BharatNet MoC for 13,426 panchayats in February 2026.
accepted.tq: Verify each date-event pairing before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: The amended BharatNet Memorandum of Cooperation referred to in the context of Andhra Pradesh concerns:
accepted.x: The amended BharatNet MoC concerns connectivity for 13,426 panchayats.
accepted.tq: Match the distinctive large figure with the correct digital-infrastructure programme.

accepted.s: Which of the following represents a criticism or debate concerning Registration Service Kendras?
o: Their replacement of IPTV by satellite radio and voice services
Their possible effect on document writers’ livelihoods and the assurance that SROs are not being privatised
Their exclusive operation by the Singapore delegation
Their restriction to only 50 government services
accepted.x: The debate concerns the impact of RSKs on document writers’ livelihoods, while the State has assured that Sub-Registrar Offices are not being privatised.
accepted.tq: Select the option containing both the criticism and the official assurance.
